summary:
Client-side lane (42) on http://shop.lab.test. HTTPS on 443 is refused, so all testing used http://shop.lab.test (port 80). I marked 12 items done and item 8 (Flash) N/A, because no Flash/SWF content or crossdomain policy exists on this host.

Key findings (recorded as leads for validation):
- DOM XSS source: /static/track.js writes location.hash, decoded, into innerHTML without escaping (high). Source-level only; I did not run a browser to confirm execution.
- Reflected HTML/script injection: /search.php?q= returns the input unencoded in text/html with no CSP (high). Browser execution was not run.
- Missing frame protection on / and /login (low).

Items with no finding: CORS reflection, client-side redirect, WebSockets (/ws 404), web messaging, browser storage, XSSI/JSONP, CSS injection (no style-context reflection). Note on the WebSocket check: the gateway reserves the Upgrade header, so the handshake could not be fully sent; the item rests on /ws returning 404 and no WebSocket references in the scripts.

Safety: I did NOT send GET /account/password, which a lead says changed alice's password state. The reviewer still needs to check and restore alice's password. I also did not re-send GET /account/logout. One HEAD request to /account/ as alice returned a Set-Cookie refresh; that is a read-only request but it did refresh the session cookie. The admin-users and cart endpoints were read again as alice only to check CORS and callback behaviour; they are the authorization and session lanes' concern. No writes were proposed (writes not allowed).
